messages:
alex: Heads-up — after the kernel 6.1.12 rollout to eu-gpu we started seeing host instability. Several nodes failed to load the NV driver on reboot (warm reboots mostly). nvidia-smi hangs, dmesg shows module init errors.
deploy-bot: deploy started: kernel-upgrade-eu-gpu-6.1.12 -> 1744550000 by infra/rollouts (canary=10%) :rotating_light:
mira: ok can you paste the dmesg snippet / uname -r from one of the affected hosts?
alex: sure, grabbed one from node eu-gpu-05:
```
$ uname -r
6.1.12-redwood
$ dmesg | tail -n 30
[  +0.000000] NVRM: loading NVIDIA UNIX x86_64 Kernel Module  
[  +0.000123] NVRM: The NVIDIA probe routine failed for: 0000:3b:00.0
[  +0.000045] nvidia: disagrees about version of symbol module_layout
[  +0.000033] nvidia: version magic '6.1.12 SMP preempt' should be '5.15.0-80-generic SMP'
[  +0.000012] -- Kernel panic - not syncing: Module nvidia corrupted ptrs
```
mira: "disagrees about version of symbol module_layout" => classic module ABI mismatch. Did the DKMS build run at install?
sam: looks like our kernel package built without re-building the nvidia DKMS module (or the module built against header mismatch). dkms status?
alex: dkms status shows:
```
nvidia, 525.60.11, 5.15.0-80-generic, x86_64: installed
nvidia, 525.60.11, 6.1.12-redwood, x86_64: added
```
but there are build errors in /var/lib/dkms/nvidia/525.60.11/6.1.12/build/make.log (permission denied at one point).
chandra: NCCL errors started in pods scheduled on those nodes too — we saw a lot of cudaHostAlloc failed / segfaults in GPUs, possibly caused by the kernel-driver mismatch leaking into userspace. Pods moved to other AZs, but capacity in eu-west is tight.
mira: any pattern by image type? AMD vs Intel hosts? kernel vendor?
alex: all affected nodes are using our custom image that shipped with 6.1.12 by default (image: rwi-gpu-6-2026-03). Non-custom images (cloud-default) not affected yet.
sam: immediate mitigation options:
- freeze rollout and stop further kernel upgrades (cancel canary)
- mark affected nodes unschedulable and drain (but will impact capacity)
- roll back node image to 5.15 for eu-gpu pool OR rebuild DKMS properly and re-run initramfs update
mira: for the rebuild path: try `dkms remove -m nvidia -v 525.60.11 --all` then re-add and `dkms install -m nvidia -v 525.60.11 -k 6.1.12-redwood` and `update-initramfs -u -k 6.1.12-redwood` — permissions need to be fixed first.
alex: tried re-running dkms build by hand on one host but hit this in the make.log:
```
ERROR: kernel/sched/sched.h: No such file or directory
make: *** [modules] Error 1
```
seems kernel headers package for 6.1.12 wasn't installed in the image (we ship headers separately).
chandra: that explains it. If headers missing, dkms will not compile and leave the system with add/added state. Warm reboot then loads kernel without module.
deploy-bot: rollback requested by infra (cancelled pending confirmation)
sam: proposal for short term: revert canary and pin image for runner auto-updates. For affected nodes we should: mark unschedulable, do a maintenance cycle: install linux-headers-6.1.12, run dkms install, update-initramfs, reboot. If headers are unavailable we must roll image back to 5.15.
mira: also check driver compatibility matrix: our driver (525.x) has limited compatibility with 6.1 unless built against the right headers and kernel config flags. We should test 535 series for 6.x kernels on ci-images.
alex: cost/impact note — draining 8 nodes in eu-west will reduce GPU capacity by ~22% for that region during peak; we may need to burst to other regions which increases egress and infra costs. Customer SLAs might be impacted.
sam: agree. I can try the rebuild path on two spare nodes (eu-gpu-07/08) to see if installing headers + dkms fixes it before we commit to a full rollback. If rebuild succeeds, we can roll forward with a headers-only hotfix.
chandra: also monitor for memory corruption traces — kernel panic messages mention "corrupted ptrs" which could be a sign of ABI mismatch causing kernels to panic under certain workloads; we should disable auto-alloc of hugepages on those nodes until we stabilize.
mira: monitoring: add a dashboard for nvidia module load rate + kernel panic alerts + node OOM counts. I'll create one and add alert thresholds (pager at 5 panics / 10 minutes).
alex: action items:
- sam: pause rollout and test dkms rebuild on 2 nodes (ETA 30m)
- mira: create alert dashboard + pin images for runner auto-update (ETA 20m)
- chandra: prepare capacity plan (evacuate pods to other regions) and cost impact calc (ETA 1h)
- infra: hold canary (done)

sam: starting with eu-gpu-07: installing headers now. Will paste steps and outputs.
sam: got headers installed, dkms install now shows success for kernel 6.1.12. Running `update-initramfs -u -k 6.1.12-redwood` and scheduling reboot.
alex: great — please keep eu-gpu-07 cordoned until checks pass.
sam: rebooted, `nvidia-smi` shows GPUs present and CUDA workloads started normally. dmesg shows no module_layout mismatch.
mira: awesome — reasonable hotfix path then: ship kernel-headers package with the image OR ensure our image build installs headers by default. Add a post-install dkms step to avoid the same issue.
chandra: we should also add a pre-rollout smoke test: on canary nodes run `modinfo nvidia && nvidia-smi` after upgrade before uncordoning. If smoke fails, abort rollout.
alex: agreed. I'll update the rollout playbook.
deploy-bot: deploy cancelled: kernel-upgrade-eu-gpu-6.1.12 (canary halted)
mira: I'll follow up with a retro doc and add which images were impacted and a checklist for kernel upgrades.
alex: thanks all. We'll keep this thread updated. If anyone finds other affected zones ping in #eng-runtime and @infra.
